Pipeline A.1 (gate, never scored) measured the JPEG-history feature s=193.2225 against t=2.0, verdict is_jpeg_derived=True from 959543 AC coefficients in R1 against 4966 in R2. Pipeline A.3 recovered QF=100 at an exact-pixel-match rate of 0.9837 (runner-up 0.9797); the file's own DQT marker independently says QF=74 (agrees=False, DC step 6). Pipeline B used 10 of 10 low-frequency positions, of which 5 carried a peak above the 0.05 prominence threshold, with per-frequency strongest prominences [0.2265, 0.0416, 0.0526, 0.0579, 0.0382, 0.0491, 0.0554, 0.0378, 0.0543, 0.048]. With the quantization-step normalisation disabled the same pipeline scores 0.0661.
images.mathematical_explanation: This engine measures double-quantization periodicity. Re-binning a coefficient population already quantized at step q_alpha into bins of a different step q_beta is a non-injective periodic remapping (Mahdian & Saic Eq. 4), so the coefficient histogram develops missing bins and periodic peaks that a singly-compressed histogram does not have. Pipeline B histograms each of 10 low-frequency DCT positions, takes the unit-normalised FFT magnitude, subtracts the trailing local minimum to strip the decaying trend (Eq. 5), and measures what peaks survive. For this image the surviving prominences were [0.2265, 0.0416, 0.0526, 0.0579, 0.0382, 0.0491, 0.0554, 0.0378, 0.0543, 0.048], averaging to raw_score=0.066134. The decisive caveat is that a null result proves nothing: the SKILL states that when the ratio of the two quantization steps is an integer, NO periodic artifact is introduced at all - a fundamental blind spot with detection accuracy near zero - and that the no-ML path additionally cannot see grid-misaligned splices or the QF1=QF2 case.

computation_steps.name: Block DCT extraction
computation_steps.description: Converted to luminance, cropped to the 8x8 block grid, and applied a level-shifted 8x8 DCT to every unsaturated block (saturated blocks are excluded so truncation error can be neglected, per the SKILL).

computation_steps.name: Pipeline A.1: JPEG-history gate (NOT SCORED)
computation_steps.description: Computed the ratio of AC-coefficient mass in R1=(-1,+1) to that in R2=(-2,-1)u(+1,+2). Used only to decide whether this module applies at all - being JPEG is not evidence of forgery.

computation_steps.name: Pipeline A.3: quality-factor recovery (CONDITIONING + CONFIDENCE)
computation_steps.description: Recompressed at every candidate quality factor and took the one reproducing the most pixels exactly. Feeds the low-QF reliability gate, the confidence discount, and the quantization steps Pipeline B needs - never raw_score.

computation_steps.name: Pipeline A.2: per-frequency quantization steps (CONDITIONING)
computation_steps.description: Estimated the quantization step at each AC DCT frequency from the histogram of rounded coefficients. The SKILL calls this a nuisance parameter, not a tampering score; it is reported for the record and used only as a fallback when the quality-factor sweep is disabled.

computation_steps.name: Pipeline B: double-quantization periodicity (SCORE-DRIVING)
computation_steps.description: Divided each selected low-frequency coefficient by its quantization step to recover the integer domain the double-quantization model is written over, histogrammed it, took the normalised FFT magnitude, removed the decaying trend by trailing-minimum subtraction, and measured the surviving peak prominences.

computation_steps.name: Scoring
computation_steps.description: Aggregate peak prominence converted to a probability via the provisional_sigmoid route.
